examples.sql: SELECT "src"."SaleID" AS "SaleID","src"."Customer" AS "Customer","src"."SaleDate" AS "SaleDate",CAST(REPLACE("src"."AmountText",',','') AS DOUBLE) AS "Amount",SPLIT_PART("src"."Path",'/',3) AS "Country",REGEXP_REPLACE("src"."Code",'[^0-9]','') AS "CodeDigits",ROUND(CAST(REPLACE("src"."AmountText",',','') AS DOUBLE) / 10) * 10 AS "AmountRounded",CONCAT(CAST(CAST(FLOOR(CAST(REPLACE("src"."AmountText",',','') AS DOUBLE) / 500) * 500 AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR),' <= x < ',CAST(CAST(FLOOR(CAST(REPLACE("src"."AmountText",',','') AS DOUBLE) / 500) * 500 + 500 AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR)) AS "AmountBand" FROM "src"
examples.statement:
LOAD SaleID, Customer, SaleDate,
     Num#(AmountText, '#,##0.00') AS Amount,
     SubField(Path, '/', 3) AS Country,
     KeepChar(Code, '0123456789') AS CodeDigits,
     Round(Num#(AmountText, '#,##0.00'), 10) AS AmountRounded,
     Class(Num#(AmountText, '#,##0.00'), 500) AS AmountBand

inputs.statement:
LOAD SaleID, Customer, SaleDate, Amount,
     If(Customer = Previous(Customer), RangeSum(Peek('RunningTotal'), Amount), Amount) AS RunningTotal
RESIDENT Sales ORDER BY Customer, SaleDate
inputs.why_rules_failed: Peek('RunningTotal') of a field computed from Peek() (recursive, e.g. a running total)

output.sql: SELECT "src"."SaleID" AS "SaleID","src"."Customer" AS "Customer","src"."SaleDate" AS "SaleDate","src"."Amount" AS "Amount",SUM("src"."Amount") OVER (PARTITION BY "src"."Customer" ORDER BY "src"."SaleDate" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "RunningTotal" FROM "src" ORDER BY "src"."Customer","src"."SaleDate"
